subject: Security exhibit onboarding: playbook, gates, and evidence action grid
messages:
From: Tom Wallace <tom.wallace@medicore.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Melissa Grant <melissa.grant@medicore.com>, legal@medicore.com
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Security exhibit / audit rights — next steps

Avery,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our legal team has asked for a tighter security exhibit and clarity on inspection rights before we can finalize the order form. High-level asks: SOC 2 report (latest), explicit pen-test window language, and clear cadence for evidence requested during renewals.

Can we get a proposed "onboarding playbook" from you that maps: 1) which evidence we'll see and when, 2) what the pen-test inspection window looks like, and 3) who to contact for evidence handoffs? If you can include a minimal list of documents we should expect (e.g., SOC2 summary, incident runbook excerpt, pen-test scope), that would help speed review.

We're looking to close the MSA + Order Form in the next 2–3 weeks; please let me know availability for a short sync.

Thanks,
Tom Wallace
Sr. Procurement Manager | Medicore Health
[tel: +1-415-555-0123]
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Tom Wallace <tom.wallace@medicore.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit / audit rights — next steps

Tom —

Appreciate the clear direction. I've sketched a short onboarding playbook and an "action grid" (who does what, by when) that addresses the three items you called out. High-level:
- Deliverables: SOC 2 summary (redacted), pen-test scope template, evidence cadence table (what we can provide and recommended frequency).
- Inspection model: remote evidence-first; limited privileged inspection only on a case-by-case basis (we'll propose a 2-week notice window in the exhibit).
- Pen-test: we propose an annual external pentest window with a 30-day staging access window for your vendor; Redwood requires a sponsored nondisclosure + scheduled window to protect tenant isolation.

I've attached a draft (redlines_v1.docx) and the SOC 2 summary (soc2_2025_summary.pdf). Proposal: 30-minute sync tomorrow 10:00–10:30 PT to walk the playbook and identify any hard blockers. Will that work?

– Avery
Avery Johnson
Partner Sales | Redwood Inference
[attachment: redlines_v1.docx] [attachment: soc2_2025_summary.pdf]
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit / audit rights — next steps

Team —

Reviewed the draft redlines. Inline summary of legal's recommended language below (high-level; I'll produce a tracked version if we agree to these points):

1) Inspection rights: replace broad "on-site inspection" language with a two-tier flow: (A) remote evidence delivery (periodic, per evidence cadence), and (B) privileged inspection by appointment only with maximum 2-day on-site presence limited to non-production observability (no direct access to customer data or keys).

2) Pen-test: limit to "non-invasive" tests without exploitation of PII or persistence; require proof of insurance and scope pre-approval. Add a default 30-day remediation hold and a defined disclosure process for findings.

3) SOC 2: provide the Type II summary and SOC 2 report under NDA (we'll provide an executive summary now; full report upon receipt of signed NDA).

4) Evidence cadence: propose quarterly evidence bundles for renewals and a lightweight monthly health snapshot (availability/uptime metrics and recent infra changes) for the first 6 months post-launch.

Open questions for product/security:
- Is the 2-day on-site cap workable operationally?
- Can we support a 30-day staging window for vendor tests?

Connor / Avery — can you confirm ops feasibility and whether we should include a slot-based staging calendar in the runbook?

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
From: Tom Wallace <tom.wallace@medicore.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Melissa Grant <melissa.grant@medicore.com>, legal@medicore.com
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 08:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit / audit rights — next steps

Laura / Avery —

That all sounds reasonable from our side. A couple items:
- We prefer a staged inspection approach (remote first). On-site is acceptable with the 2-day cap.
- For pen-test, our vendor requires a 3-week window for discovery + one week for remediation retest; would Redwood accept a 28–30 day staging window?
- We'll need a signed NDA to access the SOC 2 report. Can you send the NDA/DocuSign link and a proposed schedule?

If you can send the DocuSign now and the updated redlines (tracked) we can route to our legal and return by EOD Tuesday.

Regards,
Tom
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Wallace <tom.wallace@medicore.com>, Melissa Grant <melissa.grant@medicore.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2026 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit / audit rights — next steps

All — quick status and action grid (finalizing before we hand to legal for tracked changes):

Action grid (owners / ETA):
- Laura: produce tracked redlines with the two-tier inspection language and pen-test constraints — ETA: 2026-06-11 EOD. [owner: laura_bennett]
- Connor: confirm staging calendar feasibility and slot model; will propose a 30-day rolling window and draft operations playbook — ETA: 2026-06-12. [owner: connor_obrien]
- Neha: prepare NDA + DocuSign package and upload to the HubSpot deal along with evidence checklist — ETA: 2026-06-11 morning. [owner: neha_kapoor]
- Avery: consolidate updated SOC2 summary and attach pen_test_scope_grid.csv for Medicore's vendor — ETA: 2026-06-11 morning. [owner: avery_johnson] [attachment: pen_test_scope_grid.csv]

Tom / Melissa — next steps for you: once Laura publishes tracked redlines and Neha sends the DocuSign link, please route internally and we aim for a Tuesday review cycle.

I'll update the HubSpot deal (DEAL-7043) with the links and task checklist. If anything changes, reply to this thread. Thanks team — keeping this tight will get the order form across the line.

– Avery
Avery Johnson
Partner Sales | Redwood Inference
